words: Pattern: a whole round wheel-like or face-like arrangement around a centre, seen from a little distance so the whole thing fits with some surround. Examples: a wheel with spokes or a tyre on a car, cart or bicycle (often part of the vehicle shows), and the whole furry face of a cat, terrier or small fluffy dog. Not: flat discs such as clock faces or loudspeakers, not flowers or thistles, not a face so close that it fills the crop.
